description: This Java class 'VisitTypeEditor' is a property editor used for converting between String identifiers and VisitType objects within the OpenMRS platform. It extends a generic 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' and interacts with the OpenMRS service layer to retrieve VisitType instances by ID or UUID.

classes.name: VisitTypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor for converting String IDs or UUIDs into VisitType objects within the OpenMRS framework. It extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor and provides implementations for retrieving VisitType instances.

methods.name: VisitTypeEditor()
methods.description: Constructor for the VisitTypeEditor class; initializes the property editor.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitType object using its integer ID via the OpenMRS service.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitType object using its UUID string via the OpenMRS service.
